# Description & Purpose

This document describes the database service configuration and operations for the compliance datacenter.

# Details

- Product Overview

The database service provides managed relational database instances for applications running in the compliance datacenter. It supports MySQL 8.4 and PostgreSQL 16.

- HA architecture design

The high availability setup uses primary-secondary replication with automatic failover via HAProxy and Keepalived.


| Component   | Version   | Role           |
| ----------- | --------- | -------------- |
| MySQL       | 8.4       | Primary DB     |
| PostgreSQL  | 16.2      | Secondary DB   |
| HAProxy     | 2.8       | Load Balancer  |
| Keepalived  | 2.2       | VIP Management |
| Backup Tool | mysqldump | Full backup    |

- Backup concept

Backup default policy: Full backup every day, including full data and binary logs, with a retention period of 30 days. Incremental backups are performed every 6 hours.

```bash
# Full backup command
mysqldump --all-databases --single-transaction --routines --triggers > full_backup.sql

# Restore command
mysql < full_backup.sql
```
